raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The pie chart displays the distribution of data across three time periods: 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three slices, each representing a year and labeled accordingly. The largest slice, colored blue, corresponds to 2019 and accounts for 46.0% of the total (46 units). The orange slice, representing 2018, makes up 33.0% of the total (33 units). The green slice, labeled 2017, represents 21.0% of the total (21 units). Each slice is labeled with its corresponding year, percentage, and numerical value. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the 2019 segment at the top, followed by 2018, and then 2017. There is no legend, and the percentages and values are displayed directly within each slice.
